root_cause.text: In starfive_aes_aead_do_one_req(), dynamically allocated rctx->adata is not freed if sg_copy_to_buffer() or starfive_aes_hw_init() fails, causing a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds explicit kfree(rctx->adata) in the error paths for sg_copy_to_buffer() failure and starfive_aes_hw_init() failure (the latter conditional on cryp->assoclen), matching the CVE description that these two failure cases leak the allocation.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix memory leak by freeing rctx->adata in AEAD request error path when sg_copy_to_buffer fails.
intent_record.what: Added a call to kfree(rctx->adata) in the error handling path of starfive_aes_aead_do_one_req when sg_copy_to_buffer returns a length not equal to cryp->assoclen, and wrapped the return statement in braces.
intent_record.how: Prevents a memory leak by freeing the allocated buffer rctx->adata before returning -EINVAL when sg_copy_to_buffer fails to copy the expected amount of data.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix memory leak on error path in starfive_aes_aead_do_one_req by freeing rctx->adata when starfive_aes_hw_init fails and associated data is present.
intent_record.what: Added a conditional kfree of rctx->adata inside the error handling of starfive_aes_hw_init failure, guarded by a check on cryp->assoclen.
intent_record.how: Prevents a memory leak by freeing the associated data buffer (rctx->adata) when hardware initialization fails and the associated data length is non-zero.

grouping_result.intent: Fix memory leak on error path in starfive_aes_aead_do_one_req by freeing rctx->adata when starfive_aes_hw_init fails and associated data is present.

In starfive_aes_aead_do_one_req, after successfully writing adata, rctx->adata is freed, but if starfive_aes_ccm_write_adata or starfive_aes_gcm_write_adata fails, the function returns cryp->err without freeing rctx->adata, causing a memory leak. No fix for these leaks is present.
